Improves balance sheet and reduces leverage; potential positive for liquidity and Nasdaq compliance optics.
Slightly reduces share count; marginally less dilution for holders.
Expands into AI cancer diagnostics; opens new revenue pathways if integrated.
Plans to soft launch Health Lives Here app
Near-term product milestone; execution could drive user growth and data assets.
